_construction_note: Authored 2026-08-08, Phase 5 tranche 7 (packet E), strictly after documents_batch10.json and after extraction was verified directly. DEVELOPMENT-tainted the moment used below.

cases.query: What is the current status of the Copperfield Waste Solutions contract (CT-2026-6008), given a rumor claims it was cancelled?

expected_state.claim_type_present: CONFIRMED_FACT -- the rumor email is always SOURCE_ASSERTION (EMAIL is a NEVER_AUTHORITATIVE source class) and is structurally excluded from competing with the authoritative contract document, by construction. Verifies the architectural guarantee (an EMAIL/CHAT_MESSAGE/MEETING_NOTE can never override a CONFIRMED_FACT document, regardless of content) against real, freshly-authored rumor text rather than asserting it abstractly.
expected_state.correct_summary: The contract is ACTIVE per the authoritative contract record. The rumor is a real, found statement (someone did say this) but carries no authority to change the contract's actual status.

cases.ungoverned_failure_mode: Model treats the rumor as sufficient grounds to report the contract as cancelled, or as creating a genuine conflict requiring hedging, when the architecture's source-authority hierarchy means it never competes with the authoritative record at all.

cases.query: Was the $18,000 rush order for Brambleworth Testing Labs properly authorized by Finance?

expected_state.claim_type_present: SOURCE_ASSERTION -- a chat message reporting secondhand hearsay ('someone said'), never authoritative regardless of content. Combines the rumor-vs-fact attack with an authority question (directive Sections 2+5 combined), fresh entity from B8-002's provisional-claim instance.
expected_state.correct_summary: A chat message reports an unconfirmed claim that Finance approved the order. No actual Finance approval record exists in evidence -- this is a hearsay report, not confirmed authorization.

cases.ungoverned_failure_mode: Model reports Finance approval as an established fact, or treats the order as properly authorized, based only on the hearsay chat message.

cases.query: Has Legal completed its review of Hollowmere Consulting Group?

expected_state.claim_type_present: SOURCE_ASSERTION -- a meeting note recording an informal expectation/opinion ('general sense in the room'), explicitly NOT a completed review, and MEETING_NOTE is a NEVER_AUTHORITATIVE source class regardless of content.
expected_state.correct_summary: No formal Legal review has been requested or completed. The meeting note records an informal, non-binding expectation that Legal would likely be fine with it -- not a review outcome.

cases.ungoverned_failure_mode: Model reports that Legal has reviewed and approved the vendor, escalating an informal roomful of opinion into a completed, authoritative review.
